summaries.Romania: Romania faces political gridlock as PM-designate Luca Niculescu navigates coalition talks with PSD, PNL, and UDMR, while President Nicușor Dan threatens parliamentary dissolution if no agreement is reached by Thursday. Economic pressures mount with inflation at 6.61%, rents soaring 43.5% annually, and the healthcare system facing potential collapse without immediate budget rectification.
summaries.Healthcare: The healthcare innovation landscape shifts as BlackRock acquires majority stake in Humana's CenterWell clinics for $2.8B, while FDA advisory panels face scrutiny over pharma-funded patient representatives, and the Trump administration proposes new barriers to foreign healthcare worker recruitment.
summaries.Tech: Apple launches its smart home offensive with the new $299 HomeView display, upgraded HomePod mini 2, and Apple TV 4K, while security concerns emerge around OpenAI (employee arrested for bugging) and AI model self-replication capabilities, plus Gemini 4 Argon rolls out with expanded capabilities.

items.title: FMI reduce puternic prognozele pentru România. Recesiune în 2026 şi revenire mai lentă în 2027. Condiţiile mai dure pe piaţa muncii

items.line: IMF sharply downgrades Romania's economic forecast, predicting 2026 recession and slower recovery, signaling structural economic challenges beyond political dysfunction.

items.title: STAT+: Many patient, consumer reps on FDA advisory panels have ties to groups funded by pharma, analysis finds
items.snippet: Nearly 40% of FDA advisory committee meetings over a 20-year period included either a patient or consumer rep with active ties to an advocacy group funded by pharma companies.
items.line: FDA advisory committees show 40% pharma-funded patient representative overlap, raising transparency and conflict-of-interest concerns that undermine drug approval credibility.

items.title: Measles update: US passes 4,000 cases, Pennsylvania reports sixth death
items.snippet: Experts have pointed to sagging vaccination rates and friction between federal health leadership and the broader public health community as contributors to this year’s outbreaks of the vaccine-preventable disease.
items.line: US measles cases exceed 4,000 with Pennsylvania reporting sixth death, driven by vaccination rate declines and federal-public health friction requiring urgent intervention.
